#! -rules CONF-07 -strict
# Plain-text real name, date of birth and an INET column; a column renamed to email; a plain client_ip
# added later; ciphertext PII outside svc_identity; an @pii field outside Identity. (legacy_mail is a
# known miss: "mail" alone is not one of the listed words.) Migrations 00003-00009 add a plain PII
# column that only a misread of goose or PostgreSQL would drop or hide: a lower-case `-- +goose down`,
# a $fn1$ body, an E'' escape, a multi-line string, a nested comment, a quoted identifier with a quote,
# and a '$' inside an identifier. 00010: LIKE copies a plain email that its source then drops, a column
# changed to INET, and a SELECT ... INTO that CONF-07 cannot follow (fails closed). 00011: CREATE TABLE IF
# NOT EXISTS of a table that exists keeps it (and its email). 00012: ADD COLUMN after the descendants marker
# `*`. 00013: quoted names with no space before the type or INTO. 00014: ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS of a
# column that exists keeps it (and its INET type). 00015: a column of a domain over INET; EXPLAIN ANALYZE
# runs its CREATE TABLE … AS, and CREATE TABLE t (cols) AS names columns without types (both fail closed).
# 00016: a pg_catalog.inet column, a domain over 00015's domain, and a domain over a quoted pg_catalog.cidr.
